gallery.title: Sketches and pictures
gallery.intro: Flats, photos per colourway and image pages with numbered callouts. The main picture is the one the styles list, the gallery and the public DoC page show.

add.title: Add pictures
add.subtitle: To style {code}: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB each
add.hint: Drop JPEG, PNG or WebP pictures here, or choose them. A HEIC photo: save it as JPEG first.
add.failed: A picture was not added: the others before it are in the gallery. Try again.
add.unused_one: {count} picture already among the style’s files
add.unused_other: {count} pictures already among the style’s files
add.wrongType: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP pictures can be added.
add.tooBig: A picture holds up to 15 MB.

held.noRight: Your role can view the pictures, not change them
held.noUpload: Your role cannot send files: pick one already among the style’s files
held.archived: The style is archived: reactivate it first
held.rule: The style’s edit rule does not allow it in this state
held.offline: Offline: the pictures change once the connection is back
held.busy: Wait: a change is being saved
held.full: The style keeps at most {max} pictures: remove one first

banner.noRight: You can view the pictures, not change them.
banner.noUpload: Your role cannot send files: you can arrange the pictures and add the style’s picture files.
banner.archived: The style is archived: its pictures are read-only until it is reactivated.
banner.rule: The style’s edit rule does not allow changes in its state: move the style or start a revision first.

empty.title: No pictures
empty.body: Add flats, photos per colourway or an image page with callouts.

gallery.count_one: {count} picture · {printable} go into the tech pack PDF
gallery.count_other: {count} pictures · {printable} go into the tech pack PDF
gallery.listLabel: Pictures of the style, in order
gallery.noLook: The picture cannot be shown now
gallery.notAvailable: The file is not available yet
gallery.notInPdf: Not in the tech pack PDF (a JPEG or PNG up to 4 MB goes in)
gallery.frozen: Revision {revision} is released: this picture keeps what it shows. Move it or make it the main one; for a change, add a picture to the draft revision.

kindHint.SKETCH: A flat: front, back or a detail.
kindHint.PHOTO: A photo of the garment, for a colourway or the style.
kindHint.PAGE: A tech pack page with numbered callouts (construction details).

field.revisionHint: A picture of a draft revision is frozen with it at release.
field.caption: Caption
field.captionHint: What it shows, up to {max} characters.

edit.title: Picture details
edit.captionLong: A caption has up to {max} characters on one line

viewer.keys: ← and → move between the pictures; Esc closes.

callouts.title: Callouts on {name}
callouts.subtitle: Click the picture to place a numbered callout, or add one and type its place.
callouts.clickHint: Click to place a callout here
callouts.full: A picture has at most 60 callouts
callouts.textProblem: Give it a text of 1 to 500 characters on one line

remove.title: Remove this picture?
remove.body: {name} leaves the gallery; its file stays among the style’s files.
remove.noHeir: The style will have no main picture.

notice.held_one: {count} picture is waiting for its check: add it from the style’s files once it is ready.
notice.held_other: {count} pictures are waiting for their check: add them from the style’s files once they are ready.
notice.main: The main picture changed: the list, the gallery and the public DoC page show it.
notice.removed: Picture removed; its file stays among the style’s files.
notice.removedMain: Picture removed; the next one is the main picture now.

problem.write: The change was not saved. Try again.
problem.moved: Someone changed this picture meanwhile: the gallery was read again.
problem.state: The gallery changed meanwhile or the picture keeps what it shows: it was read again.
problem.invalid: Something typed is not valid: check the fields.
problem.gone: The picture is no longer there: the gallery was read again.
problem.offline: No connection: try again when it is back.
problem.read: The pictures could not be read. Try again.
problem.readForbidden: Your role does not read this style’s pictures.

gallery.label: Styles as pictures
gallery.looksFailed: The pictures could not be read: the styles show without them. Try again later.
gallery.looksForbidden: Your role does not read the styles’ pictures.

patterns.title: Pattern files
patterns.noRevision: Start a revision: pattern files belong to a revision.
patterns.intro: Revision {revision} ({status}) · patterns, markers and CAD files per size range (DXF-AAMA, Lectra, Gerber)

kindHint.PATTERN: The pattern pieces: the revision’s specification, frozen at release.
kindHint.MARKER: A lay plan (nest) for a cut; can be added to a released revision.
kindHint.CAD: A CAD drawing of the garment: the specification, frozen at release.
kindHint.OTHER: Any other file of the revision (a plot, a note).

add.title: Add a pattern file to revision {revision}
add.subtitle: DXF (AAMA), HP-GL plot or PDF, up to 200 MB, sent in parts
add.hint: Drop a .dxf, .plt or .pdf file here, or choose it. A native Lectra or Gerber file: export it as DXF-AAMA or a PDF plot first.
add.failed: The file was not sent. Try again.
add.wrongType: This file type cannot be sent: export it as DXF-AAMA, an HP-GL plot or a PDF.

bulk.frozen_one: {count} of them is a pattern or CAD file of released revision {revision}
bulk.frozen_other: {count} of them are pattern or CAD files of released revision {revision}

banner.noRight: You can view the pattern files, not change them.
banner.noUpload: Your role cannot send files: you can change and remove the pattern files.
banner.archived: The style is archived: its pattern files are read-only until it is reactivated.
banner.rule: The style’s edit rule does not allow changes in its state.

patterns.frozenKinds: Revision {revision} is released: its pattern and CAD files stay as they are; markers and other files can still be added.

held.noRight: Your role can view the pattern files, not change them
held.archived: The style is archived: reactivate it first
held.rule: The style’s edit rule does not allow it in this state
held.offline: Offline: the pattern files change once the connection is back
held.frozen: Revision {revision} is released: no new pattern or CAD file

patterns.frozenRow: A pattern or CAD file of released revision {revision} does not change

empty.title: No pattern files yet
empty.body: Add the pattern, the markers or the CAD drawing of this revision.

field.sizesAll: None ticked: every size of the range.
field.noteHint: What it is, up to {max} characters.
field.noteLong: A note has up to {max} characters on one line

newVersion.title: Version {version}
newVersion.body: The new version joins the file’s series; the earlier ones stay and can be downloaded.

remove.body: The files and their versions stay among the revision’s files.

notice.held: {name} is waiting for its check: it is named once it is ready.

problem.write: The change was not saved. Try again.
problem.moved: Someone changed this file meanwhile: the list was read again.
problem.state: The revision changed meanwhile or the file is frozen: the list was read again.
problem.invalid: Something chosen is not valid: check the fields.
problem.gone: The file is no longer there: the list was read again.
problem.read: The pattern files could not be read. Try again.
problem.readForbidden: Your role does not read this revision’s pattern files.
